name: Cap'n Rusty Barnacle
bio: Lost a leg to a cannonball and his ship to a card game. Wants both back, in that order.

Drive intake of 2026-11-26 ("pirate remeshed 15k", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs).
